_note: Session 39. Real, structured, durable per-candidate disposition tracking across every harvesting source list, written incrementally as each name is actually checked (see discovery/checkpoint.py) rather than only at session end — built specifically so an interruption (an org spend limit stopped Session 38's Wikipedia-list research agent partway through with nothing surviving) never loses real progress again. `status` is one of added / unscannable / unresolved / not_yet_checked. `resolved_to` names the real entry in companies.json or companies_unscannable.json when status is added/unscannable — this file intentionally does not duplicate the real reasoning/detail already recorded there, only whether/what. Seeded by cross-referencing the real, current companies.json (102 entries) and companies_unscannable.json (15 entries) against each source list's real full name set, plus Session 38's explicitly-recorded checked-negative/checked-blocked Wikipedia names and a faithful transcription of Session 38's own PROGRESS.md addendum for the LinkedIn list — not guessed from prose.
